source:
seat =>
  [NASA_OFFER, ENGINEER_OFFER, FD_OFFER, PROGRAMME_OFFER, FIRST_OFFER].find(o => o.seat === seat) || FIRST_OFFER

turningPoint =>
  ({
    nasa: NASA_OFFER,
    engineer: ENGINEER_OFFER,
    flight: FD_OFFER,
    programme: PROGRAMME_OFFER,
    gemini: GEMINI_OFFER,
  })[turningPoint] || FIRST_OFFER

(round, path = 'jpl') =>
  Array.isArray(round.path) ? round.path.includes(path) : !round.path || round.path === path
round => SITES[round.site || 'white-sands']
(id, year) => (SUCCESSIONS[id] || []).filter(s => s.from <= year).pop() || null
year => Object.assign({}, ...ROLES_FROM.filter(r => r.from <= year).map(r => r.roles))
name => name.split(' ').pop()

(vehicle, probe = false, season = null) =>
  probe || !FLOWS[vehicle] ? null : [...(EXTRA[season] || []), ...FLOWS[vehicle]]
burn => `Burnout at ${burn} seconds. Coasting.`
burn => `Brennschluss at ${burn} seconds. Coasting.`
burn => `Burnout at ${burn} seconds. Coasting.`
burn => `Cutoff at ${burn} seconds, on time. Coasting up.`
() => 'Third stage burnout. The sphere is away.'

(perigee, apogee) =>
        `Minitrack has her! Perigee about ${perigee.toFixed(0)} km, apogee about ${apogee.toFixed(0)} km. She's in orbit!`
() => 'Fourth stage burnout. The probe is away.'
f => (f.failure ? f.deep.say : `Goldstone has her. ${f.deep.say}`)

f =>
        f.failure
          ? "She's away, but she's slow. JPL will have the tracking by morning."
          : 'Mayaguez has her climbing clean. JPL takes her from here.'
() => 'Agena cutoff. Ranger has separated, panels out.'
f => (f.failure ? f.deep.say : `Goldstone has her. ${f.deep.say}`)
() => 'Ranger is on her way to the Moon. JPL takes her from here.'
burn => `WAC burnout at ${burn} seconds. Coasting up.`
(vehicle, cause) => KITS[vehicle]?.short?.[cause] ?? SHORT[cause]
g => g.site === 'cape' || blockhouseState(g.day).built
(p, near) => near(p.x) && near(p.target ?? p.x)
